# Livitech Design

> Plan. Design. Build. Supervise. End-to-end architecture, civil engineering, BOQ cost estimation, and turnkey construction platform headquartered at Patna, Bihar.

## About Livitech Design
Livitech Design (livitechdesign.in) is a premier architectural and construction engineering solutions company headquartered at Patna, Bihar. Operating across Bihar, Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh, and Northern India, Livitech Design eliminates contractor disputes and hidden material costs by providing corporate-grade project management, 100% Vastu-compliant architectural planning, scientific soil/structural analysis, and transparent itemized BOQ estimation.

1. **Residential Construction:** End-to-end turnkey home and villa construction in Bihar with guaranteed grade-A cement and TMT steel.
   - URL: https://livitechdesign.in/services/residential-construction
2. **Commercial Construction:** Multi-storey complexes, retail showrooms, hospitals, and educational facilities with municipal sanction blueprints.
   - URL: https://livitechdesign.in/services/commercial-construction
3. **Maintenance Service:** Structural repair, waterproofing, facade retrofitting, retrofitting, and facility maintenance.
   - URL: https://livitechdesign.in/services/maintenance-service
4. **Interior Design:** 3D photorealistic interior renderings, modular kitchens, wardrobes, false ceilings, and lighting layouts.
   - URL: https://livitechdesign.in/services/interior-design
5. **Architectural Services:** 2D Vastu CAD floor plans, 3D front elevations, structural detailing, and MEP engineering drawings.
   - URL: https://livitechdesign.in/services/architectural-services
6. **Contractor Services (440+ Quality Checks):** Licensed civil supervisor on-site, concrete cube testing, reinforcement tolerance audits.
   - URL: https://livitechdesign.in/services/contractor-services

## Home Construction Pricing & Packages (Bihar Benchmark Rates)
- **Essential Structure:** ₹1,550 – ₹1,750 per sq.ft (Foundation, RCC structure, TMT steel, brickwork & plaster)
- **Standard Finishing (Most Popular):** ₹1,950 – ₹2,250 per sq.ft (Fe-550D TMT, teak wood finish doors, branded sanitary, vitrified tiles)
- **Advance Finishing:** ₹2,600 – ₹3,100 per sq.ft (AAC blocks, solid teak doors, modular kitchen setup, textured paint, solar prep)
- **Bespoke Premium:** ₹3,300 – ₹4,200+ per sq.ft (Italian-spec tiles, bespoke woodwork, Apex Ultima exterior, EV charger & gas line prep)
- **Interactive Calculator:** https://livitechdesign.in/#cost-estimator

## Key Architectural & Engineering Standards
- **Vastu Shastra Compliance:** 100% directional alignment for main entrance, kitchen (Agni corner), master bedroom (Nairutya), and prayer room (Ishanya).
- **Structural Integrity:** Seismic zone IV & V calculations signed by licensed civil engineers.
- **Detailed Project Reports (DPR):** Bank-ready valuation and itemized BOQ formatted for SBI, HDFC, ICICI, and Canara Bank home loans.
- **Testing & Quality Assurance:** Concrete cube testing (M20/M25), steel tensile reports, and concealed pressure-piping leak audits.
